source.interpretation: RANDOM initiation with IQTY=3 and IQTYD=<POISSON> draws a nonnegative stochastic mission count in one IPER=12 period. IDISP=EQUIDIST places n positive-count starts evenly over [8,20), beginning at 8. The expected count is the IQTY parameter; the actual count must come from native events.

exact_delta: OperationProfile.IQTYD changes empty to <POISSON> and IDISP changes RANDOM to EQUIDIST; STIM=8, IQTY=3, IPER=12, DTIM=one-third hour and ITYPE=RANDOM remain fixed.

ProblemDescription.PDESC and Unit.DESCR change only provenance labels. All 28 other tables, three deployed aircraft, 32 replications, mission template, seed, zero failure rate and report horizon remain identical.
predeclared_native_acceptance: One immutable guarded session-0 SSH aggregate run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID 13340 identity guard, source/raw SHA-256 seals, four CLI steps and exact row-containing source roundtrip; zero conversion errors and classified warnings.
Require NREP=32 and 72 aligned half-hour system and stock bins. Do not infer 32 per-replication mission counts from averaged reports or a single exposed event log.

If all replication event groups are exposed, require the realized nonnegative count in each, starts at 8+12*k/n for k=0..n-1 when n>0, all missions successful two hours later, no cancellation/failure/stock demand, and report aircraft operation exposure equal to twice the group count. Otherwise leave those counts unverified from the aggregate alone.

Across observable independent native runs, retain actual per-replication counts and estimate their sample mean, variance and nominal 95 percent Student-t half-width; target at most one mission half-width. Require at least two distinct realized counts and no mission or stock shortage before publishing this bounded no-failure layout.
A separate read-only reviewer must replay source delta, raw seals, event counts/timings, statistics and report ledgers without importing the author validator.
limits: One Poisson-parameter value of 3, one 12-hour period, one aggregate seed, 32 aggregate replications and three deployed aircraft. Random start placement, other count distributions, zero period and invalid combinations require separate variants.
A finite seed matrix and nominal confidence interval cannot prove the native Poisson law or independence. GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
